title.from: S5: Emotion labeler style and offline fake
title.to: Optional S5: simulated-stakeholder labeler style and offline fake (for L5)

description.from:
## Purpose

An honest third labeler style for Emotion explanations.

## Scope

Input: text, gold label, one committed line of public definition per class. Output: <= 20 words quoting the words that point to the label, or 'subtle; closest cue is ...'; no invented rules. Offline fake uses a small per-emotion lexicon. Limits stated for the results.

## Specs (first, beside the module)

prompt contains text, gold label and the 6 definitions; output length <= 20 words; fake quotes a lexicon cue or the 'subtle' form; planted styles unchanged.

## Reuse

`labeler_prompt`, `wants_comment` in `unified_labeler.py`.

## Definition of done

Prompt and fake specs pass offline; definitions committed.

## Cost

$0 (offline, no network).

## Links

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md); [UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/UNIFIED_FLYWHEEL_RESULTS.md)
description.to:
## Purpose

OPTIONAL. Simulated stakeholder feedback for the optional L5 experiment only: an LLM that knows the gold label writes short reasons. Owner clarification (2026-10-01): a static labeled dataset has no stakeholder explanations; explanations are how stakeholders communicate a rubric by example over time. Emotion labels came from hashtags, so there is no consistent hidden rubric and the reasons are rationalizations. Not needed for the labels-only headline (S6-S8, L1-L3).
